assertions.predicate: Independently verify the installed full runtime SHA contains this merge and matches the on-disk intake source and installer receipt. Bind PROOF_RECEIPT to one explicit natural successful outlook-intake receipt from that installation and PROOF_RUNTIME_SHA to that full SHA. Run python3 ops/studio-proof-observe.py --receipt-file "$PROOF_RECEIPT" --service outlook-intake --runtime-sha "$PROOF_RUNTIME_SHA" --count run.attachments_pdf_stored --minimum 1. Only successfully filed attachments whose byte-admitted detected_type is pdf increment this counter. Office-only, image-only, truncated-only, generic stored/refused counts, missing PDF counts and mismatched source identity must refuse. Separately retain bounded private evidence from the same installed runtime of a naturally acquired incomplete PDF with a PDF header, no EOF in its final 1024 bytes, and type_refused before storage or filing. The scalar observer cannot establish that refusal or installation provenance. Without both independent observations remain landed-unproven. Do not launch intake, download mail or write records to manufacture evidence.
assertions.expected_result: PDF-specific receipt count meets minimum 1 at the independently verified installed SHA; non-PDF-only counts refuse. Independent natural truncated-PDF refusal and installation evidence are also required for live-proven.
assertions.input_class: One explicit natural installed outlook-intake receipt, run.attachments_pdf_stored minimum 1, independent installation/source identity and bounded private incomplete-PDF refusal evidence. Read-only; no launch or writes.
